title: Checkout Service 504 Gateway Timeout Runbook
content:
SYMPTOMS: Checkout-service throws 504 Gateway Timeout on /api/v1/checkout/pay. P99 latency spikes above 5000ms.
ROOT CAUSE: Upstream payment-gateway service or banking partner acquirer connection is failing to acknowledge requests.
DIAGNOSIS: Check service_telemetry_logs for payment-gateway error messages and bank partner response times.
REMEDIATION: Trigger circuit breaker trip to fallback provider via: `kubectl exec -it deployment/checkout-service -- /scripts/trip_circuit_breaker.sh --provider=stripe_fallback`. Notify financial operations team immediately.

title: Auth Service Redis Connection Pool Exhaustion
content:
SYMPTOMS: Auth service returns 500 Internal Server Error on /api/v1/auth/token. Error logs indicate 'RedisConnectionError: Connection pool exhausted'.
ROOT CAUSE: Session token validation leaks connections under sudden traffic bursts without releasing pool sockets.
DIAGNOSIS: Inspect telemetry logs for Redis connection error messages and peak connection counts.
REMEDIATION: Purge idle Redis socket pool and restart deployment pods via: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service -n production`. Scale connection pool ceiling in ConfigMap if traffic volume is sustained.

title: Payment Gateway P99 Latency & Connection Reset Runbook
content:
SYMPTOMS: Payment gateway /charge latency exceeding 4000ms with connection resets.
ROOT CAUSE: Primary banking acquirer socket hang or rate-limiting.
DIAGNOSIS: Verify if downstream status_code 504 is isolated to primary acquirer.
REMEDIATION: Execute emergency traffic switch to secondary banking tunnel: `kubectl set env deployment/payment-gateway ACQUIRER_ROUTE=secondary`.
